name: Bongo martillo + guiro
desc: Martillo bongo pattern - high macho drum hammering the eighths with thumb-finger alternation, low hembra answering beats 2 and 4 - over a long-short guiro scrape; peak lets the bongocero break into repique fills every fourth bar.

gain.doc: level (vcsl perc is quiet - keep high)

code.sparse: stack(s("bongo ~ bongo ~ bongo ~ bongo ~").speed("[1.5 0 1.5 0 1.4 0 1.5 0]").gain("[.42 0 .3 0 .34 0 .3 0]").shape(.4), s("~ ~ ~ ~ guiro ~ ~ ~").speed(.9).gain(${gain}*${scrape}*.6).shape(.3).pan(.6)).fast(${rate}).room(.2).orbit(2).play()
code.full: stack(s("bongo bongo bongo bongo bongo bongo bongo bongo").speed("[1.5 1.35 1.5 1 1.4 1.35 1.5 1]").gain("[.46 .26 .34 .4 .38 .26 .34 .42]").shape(.45).pan(sine.range(.44,.56).slow(16)), s("guiro ~ guiro guiro").speed("[.85 0 1.1 1.05]").gain(${gain}*${scrape}).shape(.35).hpf(600).pan(.62), s("~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ cb").gain(${gain}*.3).hpf(700).pan(.38)).fast(${rate}).room(.2).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bongo bongo bongo bongo bongo bongo bongo bongo").speed("[1.5 1.35 1.5 1 1.4 1.35 1.5 1]").gain("[.5 .3 .38 .44 .42 .3 .38 .46]").shape(.5).pan(sine.range(.42,.58).slow(12)).every(4, x=>x.ply("1 1 1 2 1 1 2 1")), s("guiro ~ guiro guiro").speed("[.85 0 1.1 1.05]").gain(${gain}*${scrape}).shape(.4).hpf(600).pan(.64), s("cb ~ ~ cb ~ ~ cb ~").gain(${gain}*.35).hpf(700).pan(.36), s("cabasa*16").gain(saw.range(.1,.22).fast(4)).hpf(2500).pan(.7)).fast(${rate}).room(.2).orbit(2).play()
